name: cd-on-exit
criterio: Mathias, 2026-10-14: quitting leaves the shell in the folder lazyfinder ends in. The function of --shell-init runs the real binary in bash: it starts in proj, opens alpha and quits; the shell is then in proj/alpha
cmd: bin="${LAZYFINDER_BIN}"; export PATH="${bin%/*}:$PATH"; cd "${TUIQA_HOME}/proj" && eval "$(command lazyfinder --shell-init bash)" && lazyfinder; echo "SHELL_IS_IN ${PWD#"${TUIQA_HOME}"/}"; sleep 3

steps.desc: the shell is in the folder lazyfinder ended in
